section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item measure with items rated 1 (never) to 5 (always) and scores averaged so higher values indicate greater body appreciation. It states the BAS demonstrated reliability and validity in prior samples and that the BAS (not BAS-2) was used because the BAS-2 had not yet been published at the time of recruitment. No sample characteristics, demographics, BMI assessment method, correlations, or study numbering are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: 2.2.1. Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos et al., 2005) The BAS comprises 13 items (e.g., "I take a positive attitude toward my body") that are rated from 1 = never to 5 = always. Item scores are averaged; higher scores reflect higher levels of body appreciation. ... The BAS was used for this research because, at the time of recruitment,the BAS-2 (Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b) had not yet been published.
